title: Mission: The Robot Arm
subtitle: Reach. Grip. Lift. Move.
summary: Explore the supplied animated robotic arm, identify its parts, and plan a pick-and-place sequence.
activityInstruction: Choose six instructions and run them in any order. Watch the load tracker. Fix mistakes until the load reaches delivery safely.

quiz.success: The gripper closes around the load.
The servo motor turns the joint.

quiz.prompt: What should the arm do before turning with a load?
quiz.success: Lift the load so it clears the table.

quiz.prompt: Which action puts the load down?
quiz.success: Lower the load to the pad, then open the gripper.

parts.label: Base
parts.fact: The mounting base supports the arm and stays fixed while the arm moves.
parts.help: Tap the black mounting foot at the bottom.

parts.label: Joints
parts.fact: Motor-driven joints let the arm bend and turn. The motor mechanisms are enclosed by these housings.
parts.help: Tap a rounded joint housing or circular joint cover.

parts.label: Arm links
parts.fact: The rigid links connect the joints and carry the gripper toward its target.
parts.help: Tap a long black or orange section between the joints.

parts.label: Gripper
parts.fact: The two-finger gripper closes to hold a load and opens to let it go.
parts.help: Tap the metal claw at the end of the arm.

exploreInstruction: Play, pause or scrub the supplied animation. Watch the arm bend, the wrist turn and the gripper open.
